name: Agency Hero
description: Agency-style hero: outline badge, oversized two-line heading beside an intro + pill CTA, then a media row pairing a large team photo (with a spinning circular contact badge) with a growth chart card and a dark stat card.
interactions: growth bars scale up from the baseline on first view, 700ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), 45ms per-bar stagger
dark card bars follow with 90ms stagger and 200ms head start
circular CONTACT US badge spins 18s linear infinite (SVG textPath)
CTA hover/active follow design-system button states, 120ms
prefers-reduced-motion: spin off, bars render in place
